cl.x: Provide Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 04.03).
Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is a high-performance liquid, alkalifree, set accelerator for shotcrete.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is suitable for both dry and wet spraying processes and it is used for:
s: Excavation stabilisation in tunnelling and mining
Rock, slope and trench stabilisation
High quality lining shotcrete

cl.x: Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

cl.l: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF has the following characteristics and advantages:
s: High early strength development
Alkali-free
Distinct reduction of rebound and dust
Improved bond of shotcrete to the substrate
Chloride-free, no negative affect on reinforcement steel
Composition: Inorganic aluminium complexes
Appearance and colour: Off white suspension
Density: ~ 1.44 kg/L
Substrate: The substrate must be clean, free of loose stones and free of water under hydrostatic pressure.
r: The substrate must be clean, free of loose stones and free of water under hydrostatic pressure.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Specific advice
cl.x: Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is added at the nozzle. Accurate and constant dosing into the concrete flow is essential. The suitability of the proposed mix design must be tested in field trials be fore commencement of the project. High quality shotcrete requires a w/c ratio of less than 0.5. Temperature of basic mix must be higher than 15°C.

s: Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 L IBC
Shelf life: 6 months from date of production if stored in original, undamaged and sealed containers.
r: 6 months from date of production if stored in original, undamaged and sealed containers.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: Storage at temperatures between 5°C and 35°C. Protect from direct sun light, frost and contamination. Use clean containers when delivered in bulk. In case of separation of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF the suspension has to be homogenised before using. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF must not be stored in standard steel containers.
Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 04.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 04.03) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: The correct dosage must be determined by preliminary testing. For layer thicknesses of up to 100 mm applied in one pass, the recommended accelerator dosage is between 5 % and 9 % by weight of binder. Lower ambient and basic mix temperatures require higher dosage of accelerator.

The accelerator’s effect depends on the content, age and type of cement, as well as on the shotcrete temperature. Furthermore, the shotcrete quality is widely affected by the substrate, the applied layer thickness, the spraying process, the quality of equipment and the application technique. The w/c ratio of the basic concrete mix in the wet spraying process, and the quantity of gauging water in the dry spraying process are also parameters influencing the acceleration effect of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF. When using sulphate resistant cements strength development can be slower. Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF is not compatible with alkaline shotcrete accelerators. Before using Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF the accelerator hoses must be cleaned thoroughly. The use of Sika® Sigunit® L-5401 AF requires technically correct dosing and conveying / spraying technology. Metal parts of the pump and piping that come into direct contact with Sika® Sigunit® L- 5401 AF must be made of stainless steel. Contact your local Sika company for any additional technical support required.

Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
